description:
Manage Assistant

Chat with Vruum: the same chat as the floating panel in the app.

- retain_job_result: no id; payload={conversation_id, expected_revision,
  expected_audience_revision, job_id, expected_job_revision, evidence_id}.
  Retain the sealed canonical account brief privately in its original chat.
  This starts no execution and grants no approval or sharing authority;
  sharing still requires an exact audience preview and confirmation.
- preview_shared_audience: no id; payload={command_id, conversation_id,
  expected_revision, expected_audience_revision, participants:[{user_id,
  may_invite?}], share_messages?, history_scope?}. Preview exact current
  audience and explicitly selected permitted history. No participant is added.
- confirm_shared_audience: no id; payload={command_id, preview_id,
  preview_fingerprint, confirmed:true}. Commit the exact displayed preview;
  retry the identical command after an uncertain response. This grants no
  sending, approval, tool or agent-execution authority.
- append_shared_message: no id; payload={command_id, conversation_id,
  expected_revision, expected_audience_revision, message}. Save a current
  participant's source-free statement. It starts no answer.
- ask_shared_conversation: no id; payload={command_id, conversation_id,
  expected_revision, expected_audience_revision, message}. Share a question
  and wait up to 50 s for Vruum's answer, which every participant sees.
  Vruum answers under your credentials with team-visible reads only (people,
  deals, pipelines, accounts, research, objectives, company profile); it
  changes, drafts, approves and sends nothing. Returns state, answer,
  withheld and tool_turns (the reads it made, never their data). Retry the
  same command_id after an uncertain response.
- revoke_shared_participant: no id; payload={command_id, conversation_id,
  expected_revision, expected_audience_revision, participant_user_id}.
  Owner removal or leaving checks current authority; retry the same command.
- reopen_context_source: id=Job UUID; payload={reference, expected_revision,
  range?}. Read the exact original from a freshly authorized Job source
  manifest. Changed, inaccessible or unavailable sources return no replacement
  bytes. This inspection never resumes work or grants effect authority.
- start_conversation: no id; payload={request_id (UUID), message,
  context?, browser_context?}. Starts a new chat and waits up to 50 s for the answer.
  context={kind: person|account|deal|objective, id} names a record to
  focus on; context={kind: people|accounts|deals, params} names a table
  and its filters (a saved view's keys). Returns chat_id, the turn
  (state completed, failed, stopped, interrupted, running or
  awaiting_approval), the question, the answer, changes and cards.
- append_message: id=chat UUID; payload={request_id, message, context?, browser_context?}.
  Sends the next message in that chat and waits the same way. One message
  runs at a time per chat.
- undo: id=a change's item UUID from changes or inspect_assistant read; no
  payload. Runs the change's exact inverse; refused when the record was
  edited since.
- decide_card: id=a pending card's item UUID from cards; payload=
  {decision: approved|declined}. Call only with the user's own decision on
  that exact card. approved runs the card's exact call once under your
  credentials; declined never runs it. Waits up to 50 s for the turn to
  continue; claimed=false means the card was already decided or expired.
- rate: id=an answer's message UUID; payload={rating: 1|-1|0, reasons?,
  comment?}. reasons: wrong_facts, did_not_do_it, wrong_record, too_slow,
  hard_to_follow, other. 0 clears the rating.
- archive: id=chat or shared conversation UUID; no payload. Archives it
  for you only: it leaves your list and stays readable with
  inspect_assistant list payload={archived: true}. Nothing is deleted and
  no one else's list changes; a later message or answer brings it back.
  Refused (409) while Vruum is answering or a card waits for a decision.
- restore: id=chat or shared conversation UUID; no payload. Returns an
  archived chat to your list.
- mark_read: id=chat or shared conversation UUID; optional
  payload={through: the chat's updated_at you read}. Clears its unread or
  needs-you mark in the app; a later answer stays unread. Answers that
  start_conversation, append_message or decide_card return are marked
  read already.
- job_start: no id; payload={request_id, request_key, request: {text,
  completion_condition, source_scope?, source_domains?, account_brief?}, guidance?}. Hands a request too
  large for one chat turn off to Vruum (shown to users as a Request in
  Agent work): it reads with your access, writes its analysis as the
  result and prepares drafts that keep their own approval. The whole
  workspace sees it; the chat stays private. The same request_key returns
  the same request. For public multi-page research, include source_domains
  (named public domains). This uses isolated browser research with search,
  fetch and rendered pages, retained sources and the same Request controls.
- job_control: id=Delegation UUID; payload={command: pause|resume|cancel|
  steer|takeover, request_id, expected_revision, guidance (steer only),
  request? (steer only, full replacement for an analysis-and-drafts Request)}.
  For an account brief, preserve its account_id, exact finish condition,
  source scope and effective time while explicitly selecting selected_offer_id
  in request.account_brief. An offer choice is never inferred from guidance.
  Its grantor controls a request; a workspace admin pauses, stops or takes
  it over after the grantor loses access. Read it with
  inspect_assistant action=job.
- responsibility_start: no id; payload={work (the public coordinated-work scope),
  receiver_user_id, brief, artifact_refs?, acknowledge_by?}. Assigns preparation
  responsibility with the authenticated caller as accountable owner. The server
  binds authentication, audience and execution; omit internal principal/fence
  fields. work.due_at is the completion deadline; acknowledge_by is separate.
- responsibility_control: id=responsibility Action UUID; payload={request_id,
  action:{id,revision}, assignment_generation, command: acknowledge|decline|
  return|reassign|cancel|report|escalate, reason, receiver_user_id? (reassign),
  evidence_refs? (report)}. Acknowledgment/reporting never approves effects.
- dependency_record: no id; payload={request_id, dependency}. Binds exact
  same-workspace Action requirements. Only registered verification can satisfy
  them; the command cannot assert a satisfied state or manufacture Evidence.
- coordination_start: no id; payload={template_id, slots, request_id,
  effective_at, observed_at} starts a plan template from inspect_assistant
  action=coordination_templates (request_id: up to 150 characters, no
  colon; dates with a time zone, kept the same on retries). Otherwise the
  payload is the typed registered assignment with request_id, context,
  capability/version, input_fingerprint, pinned input_refs, requirements
  and next_event. The server binds authentication and execution. Saves a
  durable Job; unavailable capabilities leave owned blocked work.
- qualification_start: no id; payload={request_id, subject (a coordination
  subject with its current revision), evidence (1-20 Evidence references in
  this workspace), question, effective_at, observed_at}. Starts an
  intelligence.qualification Job pinned by the server to your own current
  published qualification definition; it reads only that Evidence and
  changes nothing. 409 qualification_blocked when you have none: report the
  qualification as blocked, never answer it another way.
- coordination_control: id=coordination Job UUID; payload={command:
  pause|resume|cancel|steer, request_id, expected_revision (Job revision), reason,
  request? (full replacement assignment for steer)}. Retains the same Job and
  exact current authority; it cannot clear an uncertain attempted effect.
  inspect_assistant action=job lists the controls you may send for it.
- coordination_effect_decide: id=effect Action UUID; payload={expected_revision,
  payload_fingerprint, decision: approve|reject, reason}, both bound from
  inspect_assistant action=coordination_effect. Call only with the user's
  own decision on that exact effect. Approving runs nothing itself; the
  waiting Job re-checks and runs it. A stopped Job's effect is refused.
- work_start_propose: no id; payload={template_id + slots, or generic:
  {owner_user_id, brief, finish_condition, due_at} with subject {kind, id};
  evidence_ids?, quote?, claim_id?, receiver_user_id?, routing_reason?}.
  Suggests work for the Vruum agent to carry out once a member approves.
  Record slots (company_revision, account_id, account_revision) are filled
  from the current records. One suggestion is open per template and
  subject; a repeat attaches, and running work covers it (covered_by_job).
- work_start_approve: id=work_start Action UUID; payload={expected_version,
  mode?: once|standing}. Call only with the user's own approval of that
  suggestion: the Vruum agent then starts and owns its Job; every touch,
  spend or publication still asks on its own.
- work_start_decline: id=work_start Action UUID; payload={expected_version,
  verdict: not_work|not_now, reason?}. Only with the user's own verdict.
- work_start_reassign: id=work_start Action UUID; payload={expected_version,
  receiver_user_id (a current member), reason?}. Routes the suggestion to
  someone else; it decides nothing.
- standing_approval_grant: no id; payload={template_id, scope: {kind:
  workspace|objective|owner, objective_id?}}. Only with the user's own
  decision: the Vruum agent then starts that template's suggestions in
  the scope without asking; every touch, spend or publication still asks.
- standing_approval_control: id=standing approval UUID; payload=
  {expected_revision, command: pause|resume|cancel|take_over}.
- conflict_decide: id=work_conflict Action UUID; payload={expected_version,
  keeper_job_id (one competing Job's UUID, or null to let every Job it
  names proceed), reason}, bound from inspect_assistant action=conflict.
  Call only with the user's own decision. The others wait until the kept
  Job finishes; deciding sends nothing itself.
- reopen_company_source: no id; payload={document_id (a search_kb result id)
  or connection_id + source_record_id, expected_revision?, first_section?,
  section_count? (1-10, default 10)}. Read a window of one knowledge
  document as yourself: start at a search_kb best_section or a text match's
  section with a small section_count, then widen or page on with
  current_reference.revision and the next first_section. A changed revision returns no text; an
  inaccessible document reads as unavailable.

browser_context={binding_id, snapshot_id} is an optional immutable Radar
page reference, separate from CRM context. Keep it unchanged on retries.
Read saved evidence with inspect_assistant action=browser_source.

Vruum reads your records and applies reversible record changes at once
(notes, tasks, roles, contact choices, deal stages), each listed in
changes with Undo. Other actions (archive, objective members, launch, a
one-off send, paid lookups) become a card: the turn returns
state=awaiting_approval and nothing runs until decide_card. It never
approves drafts. A turn still running after 50 s returns state=running:
read the chat later with inspect_assistant. Keep the same request_id when you retry
after an uncertain response; the server runs each request once. Call only
after the user asks for the message to be sent.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

Chat with Vruum support (assistant_conversations):
Product support is not permission. Inspect current work and follow the domain's authorization and review rules.
- start_conversation: manage_assistant action=start_conversation. Start a chat with one message and wait up to 50 s for the answer. The same request UUID reaches the same chat and turn on a retry.
- append_message: manage_assistant action=append_message. Send the next message in a chat and wait the same way. One message runs at a time per chat.
- undo: manage_assistant action=undo. Undo one record change the chat applied, by its item ID. Refused when the record was edited since.
- decide_card: manage_assistant action=decide_card. Decide one pending card by its item ID: approved runs its exact call once under the caller's credentials; declined never runs it.
- rate: manage_assistant action=rate. Rate one answer up or down with optional reasons; 0 clears it.
- list: inspect_assistant action=list. Page the current member's chats in the workspace, newest first.
- read: inspect_assistant action=read. Read a chat's messages with full text, its turns, its record changes and the reader's ratings. Follow next_before_sequence.
- browser_source: inspect_assistant action=browser_source. Read the original member's saved Radar page snapshot in bounded text pages.
- sharing: inspect_assistant action=shared_conversation. The chat's owner shares chosen messages with teammates after a preview; participants read the shared conversation and ask Vruum read-only questions there. Other messages stay with their author.

action.description: The operation to perform — see the tool description for the action vocabulary and each action's id/payload semantics.
action.title: action

for_company.description: Optional company ID or name (UUID, or case-insensitive EXACT name match — partial / substring matches are NOT supported; ambiguous names raise 400) to execute this tool as. Use get_operator_companies, or get_operator_overview with view='companies', to list available companies. Only needed if you manage multiple companies. Access is enforced server-side: the tool resolves the value to a user_company_id and verifies the caller's membership in `company_users` — a 403 'Company not found or access denied' means EITHER the value did not match a known company OR the caller is not a member of it. The MCP operator role itself is NOT auto-granted — operators get this access by being members of each client company via `company_users` (the same row that grants any normal user access).
for_company.title: for_company

id.description: Target entity id, or an ARRAY of ids to apply the same action+payload to each (max 100; see the tool description for which entity the id names per action).
id.title: id

items.description: For create-like actions only: an array of per-item payloads processed in order with per-item results (max 100). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `payload`.
items.title: items

payload.description: Action-specific fields, validated by the underlying route. When the shape is unclear, fetch type=operation_contract with id='<tool>/action=<action>' for the exact nested schema; a tool-family id lists its operations. Reuse known contracts rather than fetching before every write.
payload.title: payload
